reviews_captured_by_me.text: 05/25/2021. We contracted the Wolston’s for a pretty big job and wow did they meet the task head on with 100% professionalism. Here are the key take aways 1. They will start the job at the time they tell you and never over book their ability. 2. They keep a very neat workspace. 3. Their work is phenomenal, 100% flawless. 4. Their prices are very fair. Overall we honestly couldn’t be more satisfied with their business. How often do you hire contractors that are punctual, clean, neat and pricing in the end doesn’t change from the original contract on day one? You get all that when you hire Wolston Elite Tile. Very happy customer for life.
